mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.permission_code IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.role_code IS NOT NULL
